new_lens_seeds.title: Spectacle As Street Army
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A scandal or humiliation scene can be staged so supporters feel their leader is cornered by a corrupt elite, turning spectacle into recruitment for street-level political force rather than mere persuasion.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism could connect Trump/Epstein theater, fifth-generation conflict, elite-overproduction civil-war pressure, public humiliation, and screen-world governance.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold as a seed. Proximity Games already carries this source in a durable anchor, and a standalone child would be premature unless later sources repeat the spectacle-to-street-force mechanism beyond this case.

new_lens_seeds.title: Elite Nexus Beyond National Loyalty
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A broker or institution can serve overlapping intelligence, criminal, foreign-state, and secret-society circuits at once, making exclusive national loyalty the wrong analytic frame.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism could clarify Jiang's recurring claims about Epstein, Israel, CIA/Mossad/MI6, drug finance, media intermediaries, and transnational elite coordination.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold as a seed with explicit attribution caveats. The existing Secret Society page already covers the coordination technology, and this source alone is too sensitive and topic-loaded for a public child.
